description: This file defines controller functions for managing OpenAI assistants, including listing assistants, retrieving a single assistant, downloading files from an assistant, and uploading files to an assistant. It handles HTTP requests and responses, interacts with services and database entities, and manages file streaming.

methods.name: getAllOpenaiAssistants
methods.description: Handles request to list all available OpenAI assistants, requiring a credential query parameter.

methods.name: getSingleOpenaiAssistant
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OpenAI assistant by ID, requiring credential and ID parameters.

methods.name: getFileFromAssistant
methods.description: Streams a file from an assistant based on chatflowId, chatId, and filename provided in the request body.

methods.name: uploadAssistantFiles
methods.description: Handles uploading files to an assistant, validating file types and MIME types, and calling the service to store files.
